meta.title: IP positioning advisor
meta.description: Trout, a five-stage interview consultant for personal IP positioning. Click "IP positioning advisor" at the foot of the left sidebar to open a new chat with the opening line already staged; sending it starts the Step 0 interview. The five stages cover motive and resources, audience, persona, business and content, and finish with a complete positioning plan in the standard template, plus an optional first batch of 30 content topics. Long interviews compact older turns automatically so confirmed stage summaries survive.
